standing: AUTHOR feasibility finding for the additional two-binding default+explicit cell. NOT a claimed control, NOT agreement. No two-binding Run is asserted to replay.
question: Can a single cell carry a default-unit binding at ordinal 0 and a lawful explicit-plan-selection binding at ordinal 1, with full owner replay, using the existing TypeScript pilot construction?
answer: Not with the existing pilot's evidence set. The blocking obligations are constructive, not contradictory: a second binding is a second PROGRAM and needs its own inventoried config/source bytes, its own per-programOrdinal inventories, and its own per-universe cell-bound coverage. Each obligation below was observed, not inferred.

orderedObligationsObserved.meaning: Two AVAILABLE bindings in one cell must name distinct universes (enumeration_model.v1.py, seen_u accumulation). Copying the default binding is therefore never a lawful second program.
Subject inventories are keyed by (cellOrdinal, programOrdinal). The pilot mints file/package/symbol inventories only at programOrdinal 0, so ordinal 1 has no inventory record.

A DISTINCT universe cannot be conjured by editing a synthetic field: its programRootFiles must be inventoried snapshot paths. The TS pilot inventories exactly one TypeScript source (src/index.ts), so a second universe requires new inventoried source and/or a second tsconfig graph.

notObservedBecauseBlockedEarlier.why: Reaching it requires clearing the three above. Under execution-inputs section 5 the ordinal-1 account's coverageIds must equal the complete matching returned partitions for (cell, program, relation, resolution, U2, producer), and a cell-bound view may not mix universes, so a second per-universe view/scope/coverage set is required.
One outcome per (cellOrdinal, programOrdinal) is required; the pilot emits only (i, 0).

whatWouldBeNeeded: A second inventoried TypeScript program: additional snapshot source and/or a second tsconfig graph, so a genuinely distinct native.semantic-universe.typescript.v2 exists with inventoried programRootFiles.
file/package/symbol subject inventories minted at programOrdinal 1 with that binding's own extents.
nativeCoverageAccounts for (cellOrdinal, 1) whose coverageIds equal the complete matching returned partitions at the second universe, carried by views/scopes/coverage minted at that universe.
Facts at the second universe, or lawful empty populations with the matching carriers.
honestStatus: The additional two-binding cell remains UNBUILT and UNTESTED as a positive control. It is not mislabelled: the shipped F-06 control is a SINGLE binding of non-default provenance, never described as two bindings. No agreement was manufactured.
defectAssessment: No owner defect is demonstrated here. Every refusal is the owner correctly enforcing a published obligation against an incomplete construction. Nothing was normalized away in the constructor to make it pass.
